## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're facing.

Example: "I find it frustrating when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe the use case for this feature. Who would benefit and how?

## Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, share them here.

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request.

---

**Checklist**:
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have considered the scope and complexity of this feature
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals
